name: Spectra
description: Dual-instrument optical UI verification referee over stdio (Meta SAM 3.1 segmentation + Pixel NCC template matching) with a 4.10% cross-instrument delta cutoff and 1.35% 3-sigma noise floor. Read-only verification checks inherit policy; invariant compilation and closed-loop CSS repair patch synthesis require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Run spectra_verify over stdio as a pre-commit or pre-merge optical gate on settled UI clips (.mp4); accept only the verdict value "pass", and fail closed on errors, "fail", and "inconclusive".
Keep spectra_closed_loop in review state so CSS repair patches synthesized via remote inference are inspected before modifying repository stylesheets.
Prefer cached deterministic verification fixtures in CI, or scope META_API_KEY and BASETEN_API_KEY strictly to the stdio MCP server process.
